name: Kogge-Stone Parallel Prefix Sum
definition: A parallel prefix sum algorithm consisting of a single phase (unlike Blelloch's two-phase approach), computing inclusive prefix sums in-place.
summary: The Kogge-Stone Parallel Prefix Sum is a single-phase in-place algorithm that simplifies verification and ensures data race freedom through explicit synchronization, distinguishing it from two-phase methods like Blelloch's.
